title: LocatorRecommendation
description: Output of the analyze-locator-candidates prompt: the agent's recommended locator for one target element, chosen from a DiscoveryResult's candidates.

targetDescription.description: The plain-language description of the element the agent was asked to locate, e.g. "the Submit button on the login form".

recommendedCandidate.description: The chosen candidate, copied verbatim from the input DiscoveryResult's matching element.candidates[] -- must have marker == UNIQUE. Null when no safe candidate exists.

confidence.description: Agent's confidence that recommendedCandidate correctly and stably targets the described element.

warnings.description: e.g. "No UNIQUE candidate found -- best available is NOT_UNIQUE (3 found)", "Only a DYNAMIC/STRUCTURAL candidate exists -- review manually before use".
